root_text:
No need to panic about HMPV, stay vigilant. If you experience symptoms like cold, cough or fever, consult a doctor and follow the guidelines issued by the government. Let us all join hands to combat the virus.

#HMPV #HMPVVirus #StaySafe #R

nodes.author: RajivMagal
nodes.text: @dineshgrao Yes No need to panic... Minister is right - as it is new-mothers (ಬಾಣಂತಿಯರು) are used to suffering from deaths and now it is the turn of young children...  Govt can not be responsible for both deaths and births... they only rule and rule and rule@!

nodes.author: BHAGAT_G_SINGH
nodes.text:
@RajivMagal @dineshgrao Birth and death is not in the hands of a human,
As health minister we are lucky to have DGR sir who is completely dedicated and involved in health ministry almost nonstop 24/7,
One of the best performing minister in the current govt.
Continue with the good work sir.

nodes.author: dineshgrao
nodes.text: ಹೆಚ್‌ಎಂಪಿವಿ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆತಂಕ ಬೇಡ, ಜಾಗೃತಿಯಿರಲಿ. ಶೀತ, ಕೆಮ್ಮು, ಜ್ವರದ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳು ಕಂಡು ಬಂದರೆ ವೈದ್ಯರನ್ನು ಭೇಟಿಯಾಗುವುದು ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಹೊರಡಿಸಿರುವ ಮಾರ್ಗಸೂಚಿಗಳನ್ನು ಪಾಲಿಸಿ. ವೈರಸ್‌ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಹೋರಾಡಲು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಕೈ ಜೋಡಿಸಿ. https://t.co/k4l7iTrHn7
